title: Towards In-context Scene Understanding (Hummingbird)
mechanism: Dense in-context prediction by nearest-neighbour retrieval from a memory of annotated patch features; pretraining with within- and across-image attention makes features suited to retrieval.
evidence: R: approaches finetuned specialists on scene understanding without modification; adapts to new tasks more efficiently than finetuning.
adaptation: Retrieval head on the house model: memory of patch features (house decoder at 1/2-1/4 res or DINOv2) from the fold's train cells, kNN label votes fused with house logits by a val-tuned weight; same-source retrieval variant to model source label conventions; targets splice (never predicted), gridline (recall 0.33), inactive.
min_experiment: cv5v2 house PF fold models with vs without kNN fusion (any-source and same-source); out-of-fold mIoU_rob and splice/gridline/inactive IoU; kill if mIoU_rob gain under margin M and no class above +0.02. No training, about 1 GPU-h.
prior_overlap: none; no nonparametric or retrieval head was ever tried.
